reasons.plausibility: Using a thin Al2O3 interlayer as a diffusion barrier in Cr–Zr systems is based on well-established diffusion-blocking principles and appears scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: A clear, feasible experiment with side-by-side coated samples and direct microstructural/chemical analysis provides a decisive way to determine if the interlayer reduces interdiffusion and preserves coating integrity.
reasons.usefulness: This directly addresses the Cr–Zr interdiffusion issue under normal and accident conditions and proposes a practical, testable solution with explicit performance criteria.
